appName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions, the toolbar tooltip, and the Web Store listing.

appDescription.message: Save the current page to your reading list and revisit it anytime.
appDescription.description: One-line extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the Web Store listing.

toastArticleAdded.description: On-page toast after a successful save via the keyboard shortcut or right-click menu.

toastArticleAddedNearLimit.message: Article added! Storage $PERCENT$% full — export a backup from Options soon.
toastArticleAddedNearLimit.description: On-page toast after a successful save that also crosses the near-quota threshold.

toastAlreadyAdded.description: On-page toast when the page being saved is already on the list.

toastCouldntSavePage.description: On-page toast when a save via the keyboard shortcut or right-click menu fails.

contextMenuAddToList.description: Right-click context menu item on a page or link.

contextMenuOpenManager.description: Right-click context menu item on the toolbar icon itself.

installNotificationTitle.description: Title of the one-time OS notification shown right after install.

installNotificationMessage.message: Click the puzzle-piece icon in Chrome's toolbar and pin Read Later so it stays right next to the address bar.
installNotificationMessage.description: Body of the one-time OS notification shown right after install.

fabLabelDefault.message: Save this page to Read Later
fabLabelDefault.description: aria-label/title on the on-page floating button when the page isn't saved yet.

fabLabelUnread.message: Saved — double-click to mark as read, hold to remove
fabLabelUnread.description: aria-label/title on the on-page floating button when the page is saved and unread.

fabLabelRead.message: Read — double-click to mark as unread, hold to remove
fabLabelRead.description: aria-label/title on the on-page floating button when the page is saved and read.

fabLabelSavedNearLimit.message: Saved — storage $PERCENT$% full, export a backup from Options soon
fabLabelSavedNearLimit.description: aria-label/title on the floating button right after a save that crosses the near-quota threshold.

fabErrorUnreachable.message: Couldn't reach Read Later — try refreshing the page.
fabErrorUnreachable.description: Floating button error state when the background service worker can't be reached.

fabErrorSaveFailed.description: Floating button error state fallback when a save fails without a specific error message.

fabErrorUpdateReadStatus.description: Floating button error state when toggling read/unread fails.

fabErrorRemoveFailed.description: Floating button error state when removing the page fails.

statusSaved.description: Brief status text shown in Options after toggling a setting or exporting.

importErrorNoArticles.message: Couldn't find any articles in that file — expected a Read Later JSON export or a Pocket CSV export.
importErrorNoArticles.description: Options import error when the chosen file can't be parsed as either supported format.

importSummary.message: $ADDED$ added, $SKIPPED$ skipped (already on your list, or missing a valid URL) — $TOTAL$ in the file.

importSummaryNearLimit.message: $SUMMARY$ Storage is now $PERCENT$% full — consider archiving old articles.
importSummaryNearLimit.description: Options import result summary, appended when the import crosses the near-quota threshold.

importFailed.description: Options import error when importReadingListItems itself throws.

readerBtnTitle.message: Open reader view (cached, works even if the page is offline)
readerBtnTitle.description: Title/tooltip on the Manager's per-item reader-view button.

tagBtnTitle.description: Title/tooltip on the Manager's per-item tag-edit button.

markAsUnread.description: Title/tooltip on the Manager's per-item read-toggle button, when the item is currently read.

markAsRead.description: Title/tooltip on the Manager's per-item read-toggle button, when the item is currently unread.

deleteBtnTitle.description: Title/tooltip on the Manager's per-item delete button.

tagsInputPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the Manager's inline tag-editing input.

saveBtnNoActivePage.description: Title/tooltip on the popup's Save button when there's no active tab to save.

saveBtnCantSavePage.description: Title/tooltip on the popup's Save button when the active tab isn't an http(s) page.

saveBtnAlreadySaved.description: Title/tooltip on the popup's Save button when the active tab is already on the list.

saveBtnSaveCurrentPage.description: Title/tooltip on the popup's Save button in its normal, savable state.

saveBtnLabelSaved.description: Visible label on the popup's Save button when the active tab is already saved.

saveBtnLabelSaveCurrentPage.description: Visible label on the popup's Save button in its normal, savable state.

usageSavedNearLimit.message: $COUNT$ / $MAX$ saved — $PERCENT$% full. Export a backup from Options soon.
usageSavedNearLimit.description: Storage usage line in the Manager once storage is near its quota.

usageSaved.description: Storage usage line in the Manager under normal storage levels.

statusSavedNearLimit.message: Saved! Storage $PERCENT$% full — export a backup soon.
statusSavedNearLimit.description: Popup status line after a save that crosses the near-quota threshold.

statusSavedExclaim.description: Popup status line after a successful save.

statusAlreadySaved.description: Popup status line when the current page was already on the list.

statusCouldntSavePage.description: Popup status line fallback when a save fails without a specific error message.

selectModeExit.description: Title/tooltip on the Manager's select-mode toggle button, while select mode is active.

selectModeEnter.description: Title/tooltip on the Manager's select-mode toggle button, while select mode is inactive.

bulkBarCount.description: Count shown in the Manager's bulk-action bar.

bulkBarClear.description: Bulk-action bar's select-all button label, when every visible item is already selected.

bulkBarSelectAll.description: Bulk-action bar's select-all button label, when not every visible item is selected.

bulkMarkedRead.description: Popup status line after a bulk mark-as-read action.

bulkDeletedSingular.description: Popup status line after a bulk delete of exactly one item.

bulkDeletedPlural.description: Popup status line after a bulk delete of more than one item.
